description: Discriminating test: among the 102 human proteins sharing NOL4's exact annotation provenance (GO:0003723, TAS, PINC), how many have an RNA-related UniProt keyword or a canonical RNA-binding domain in InterPro, and is NOL4 the residual outlier?
code:
import requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S = requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'Accept':'application/json'})
Q = "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search"
accs, meta = [], {}
for page in (1,2):
    r = S.get(Q, params=dict(goId='GO:0003723', taxonId='9606', geneProductType='protein',
                             goUsage='exact', evidenceCode='ECO:0000304', assignedBy='PINC',
                             limit=100, page=page), timeout=40).json()
    for a in r['results']:
        acc=a['geneProductId'].split(':')[1]
        if acc not in meta: accs.append(acc); meta[acc]=(a.get('symbol','?'), a.get('reference','?'))

U="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
kw, ipr = {}, {}
for i in range(0,len(accs),40):
    q=" OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a in accs[i:i+40])
    r=S.get(U, params={'query':q,'fields':'accession,gene_primary,keyword,xref_interpro',
                       'size':500,'format':'json'}, timeout=60).json()
    for e in r.get('results',[]):
        a=e['primaryAccession']
        kw[a]=set(k['name'] for k in e.get('keywords',[]))
        ipr[a]=set(x['id'] for x in e.get('uniProtKBCrossReferences',[]) if x['database']=='InterPro')

RNA_KW = {'RNA-binding','Ribosomal protein','Ribonucleoprotein','rRNA processing','mRNA processing',
          'mRNA splicing','tRNA processing','Translation regulation','Nuclease','Helicase',
          'RNA-mediated gene silencing','Ribosome biogenesis','Initiation factor','Elongation factor',
          'Spliceosome','RNA-directed DNA polymerase','Hydrolase','Methyltransferase','Isomerase'}
# canonical RNA-binding domain InterPro accessions
RBD = {'IPR000504':'RRM','IPR035979':'RRM sf','IPR004087':'KH','IPR004088':'KH type-1',
       'IPR036612':'KH sf','IPR014720':'dsRBD','IPR001159':'dsRBD','IPR001878':'Zn knuckle CCHC',
       'IPR001313':'Pumilio','IPR006630':'La','IPR002344':'La','IPR003029':'S1','IPR022967':'S1 sf',
       'IPR002059':'cold-shock','IPR012677':'nucleotide-binding alpha/beta plait',
       'IPR000467':'G-patch','IPR003954':'RRM nucleolar','IPR009818':'PAZ','IPR003165':'SAM/PAZ',
       'IPR002999':'Tudor','IPR001374':'RNase III','IPR000999':'RNase III domain',
       'IPR001650':'helicase C','IPR011545':'DEAD/DEAH box','IPR014001':'helicase ATP-bd',
       'IPR000061':'SWAP/Surp','IPR003034':'SAP','IPR000571':'Zn finger CCCH',
       'IPR001163':'Sm-like','IPR010920':'LSM sf','IPR001885':'Ribosomal'}

rows=[]
for a in accs:
    if a not in kw: continue
    has_kw = bool(kw[a] & RNA_KW)
    hits   = sorted(RBD[x] for x in ipr.get(a,set()) & set(RBD))
    rows.append((a, meta[a][0], meta[a][1], has_kw, hits))

neither=[r for r in rows if not r[3] and not r[4]]
print(f"Cohort evaluated: {len(rows)} proteins")
print(f"  with an RNA-related UniProt keyword           : {sum(1 for r in rows if r[3])}")
print(f"  with a canonical RNA-binding domain (InterPro): {sum(1 for r in rows if r[4])}")
print(f"  with at least one of the two                  : {len(rows)-len(neither)} "
      f"({100*(len(rows)-len(neither))/len(rows):.1f}%)")
print(f"  with NEITHER                                  : {len(neither)}\n")
print("Residual set (no RNA keyword, no canonical RBD):")
for a,sym,ref,_,_ in sorted(neither, key=lambda r:r[1]):
    print(f"   {a:8s} {sym:10s} ref={ref:16s} InterPro n={len(ipr.get(a,[])):2d}  kw={sorted(kw[a])}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,4.4))
cats=['RNA-related\nUniProt keyword','canonical RNA-binding\ndomain (InterPro)','either one','neither']
vals=[sum(1 for r in rows if r[3]), sum(1 for r in rows if r[4]),
      len(rows)-len(neither), len(neither)]
cols=['#4a7fb5','#4a7fb5','#2e7d5b','#c0392b']
b=ax.bar(cats, vals, color=cols)
for rect,v in zip(b,vals): ax.text(rect.get_x()+rect.get_width()/2, v+1.2, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('proteins')
ax.set_ylim(0, len(rows)+12)
ax.set_title('NOL4 against the 102 human proteins that share its annotation provenance\n'
             '(GO:0003723, TAS evidence, assigned by PINC)', fontsize=10)
ax.text(3, vals[3]+9, 'NOL4 is in\nthis group', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#c0392b')
ax.axhline(len(rows), ls=':', c='grey', lw=1)
ax.text(0.02, len(rows)+2, f'cohort n = {len(rows)}', fontsize=8, color='grey')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
